formal_statement: ∀ (n N M : ℕ) (pw : Fin N → ℕ) (lw : Fin M → ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin M → Prop) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → Function.Injective pw → Function.Injective lw → (∀ (p1 : Fin N) (l1 : Fin M), pw p1 ≠ lw l1) → (∀ p2 : Fin N, pw p2 < n) → (∀ l2 : Fin M, lw l2 < n) → (∀ (P : Finset (Fin N)) (Y : Finset (Fin M)), P.card ≤ 2 → Y.card ≤ 2 → (∀ p3 ∈ P, ∀ l3 ∈ Y, ¬ I p3 l3) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C (fun k3 : Fin n => decide (k3.val ∈ P.image pw ∪ Y.image lw)) = false) → ∀ (j a b : ℕ) (p p' : Fin N), (j < C.gates.length ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ ((((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).inputs.getD 0 0) = a ∧ ((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).inputs.getD 1 0) = b) ∨ (((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).inputs.getD 0 0) = b ∧ ((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C j).inputs.getD 1 0) = a))) → a ≠ b → (∀ z1 : Fin n → Bool, (∃ h1 : pw p < n, z1 ⟨pw p, h1⟩ = true) → (C.wires (List.ofFn z1)).getD (b) false = true → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C z1 = true) → (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun k5 : Fin n => decide (k5.val = pw p)))).getD (a) false = true → (∀ z2 : Fin n → Bool, (∃ h2 : pw p' < n, z2 ⟨pw p', h2⟩ = true) → (C.wires (List.ofFn z2)).getD (a) false = true → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C z2 = true) → (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun k6 : Fin n => decide (k6.val = pw p')))).getD (b) false = true → False
plain_statement: Points and lines are distinct input wires; take an AND/OR circuit, each gate reading exactly two earlier wires; the circuit is false whenever at most two points and two lines are true with no true point on a true line. For an AND gate on wires a and b (a, b distinct) and points p, p' (p = p' allowed), it is impossible that: the output is true wherever p and b are, a is true on p alone, the output is true wherever p' and a are, and b is true on p' alone.
title: Forced root lemma: in a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit sound on two points and two lines, no AND serves p through b and p' through a
